board.name: LilyGo T-2CAN
board.notes: For the T-2CAN fitted with an MCP2518FD. If reading the onboard controller's CANSTAT register returns 0x80, it is an MCP2515 and the other file applies.

ports.name: Status LED
ports.notes: GPIO35 is only free because this firmware leaves PSRAM uninitialised.

ports.name: Automatic precharge
ports.notes: Collides with the wiring option B/C battery_wakeup pins; enable at most one of the two.

ports.name: BMS power (wiring option A/B, bottom header pin 3)
BMS power (wiring option C, top connector)
ports.notes: Wiring option C. Pairs with the GPIO1 equipment stop and the option B/C battery wake-up pins.

ports.name: Equipment stop (wiring option A/B, bottom header)
Equipment stop (wiring option C, top connector)
ports.notes: Wiring option C. Pairs with BMS power on GPIO2.

ports.name: Battery wake-up (wiring option A, top connector)
Battery wake-up (wiring option B/C, bottom header)
ports.notes: Frees GPIO1 and GPIO2 for the I2C display or for the option C equipment stop and BMS power, at the cost of the automatic precharge pins.

ports.name: I2C display (wiring option B, top connector)
ports.notes: Wiring option B. Requires the bottom-header battery wake-up pins instead of the top-connector ones.

ports.name: SMA inverter contactor enable
ports.notes: Input from the inverter on GPIO46, a boot-mode strapping pin with an internal pull-down. An inverter holding it high while the emulator resets changes the boot mode, and high here with the BOOT button held is an invalid combination.

ports.name: CAN FD add-on
ports.notes: Bottom header only, no controller fitted from the factory. GPIO37 is free because PSRAM is left uninitialised.

ports.name: RS485 add-on
ports.notes: GPIO43/44 are the UART0 pins, so ROM bootloader output goes out the bus at 115200 baud for a moment after reset.

ports.name: CHAdeMO connector
ports.notes: Takes over the second and third battery contactor pins, so disable those two ports when enabling this one. The ct pin is on ADC1, which stays usable with Wi-Fi up.
